function.name: call_uber
function.description: Requests an Uber ride to the specified pickup location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The address, city, or ZIP code of the pickup location, formatted as 'Street Address, City, State, ZIP Code' (e.g., '123 Main St, Springfield, IL, 62701').

ride_type.description: The type of Uber ride to request.

passenger_count.description: The number of passengers for the ride.

payment_method.description: The preferred payment method for the ride (e.g., 'Credit Card', 'Uber Credits', 'PayPal').

promo_code.description: A valid promotional code for discounts on the ride, if applicable.
